description: This file appears to be a shell script or documentation comments outlining a procedure for validating WAN IPv4 and IPv6 connectivity using ping commands. It describes prerequisites, the purpose, and contains example commands for performing pings and processing their output to assess packet loss and latency.
calls: $ R "ping -c 2 -w 4 1.1.1.1 | sed -E 's/time=[0-9\.]+/time=X.Y/g;s/([0-9]+)% packet loss/PL=\\1%/g' | grep -E 'icmp_seq=|PL=' | sort | uniq"

$ R "ping -6 -c 2 -w 6 2606:4700:4700::1111 2>&1 | sed -E 's/time=[0-9\.]+/time=X.Y/g;s/([0-9]+)% packet loss/PL=\\1%/g' | grep -E 'icmp_seq=|PL=|Name or service not known|No route to host|Network is unreachable' | sort | uniq"
